name: Minimum Teaching-Set Size / Degeneracy
details: The proposed bound $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{d}_{\min}^*(\mathcal H)$ fails by an unbounded factor.
proof: In the cube-with-apex class $\mathcal A_n$, the apex has a one-point teaching set, whereas the base subfamily is a full $n$-cube and gives degeneracy $n$.
witness_verification: For every $n\geq1$, the established values are $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal A_n)=1$ and $\mathrm{d}_{\min}^*(\mathcal A_n)=n$.
